column1: # SemR's fragment of trust-ir level R (Trust proven-core RM4): the Rust `Inst`
# variants whose semantics is SemR's (`lean/semr/SemR.lean`), each beside the
# SemR `Inst` constructor that decodes and runs it. From RM4 the parity gate for
# (`inst_parity_reads_semr_for_its_fragment`) holds the names to SemR.lean, and
# (`semr_parity_gate_*`) holds the semantics: over every SemR differential's
# runs, every variant here is executed (`semr_eval --executed`) by an agreeing
# SemR/interpreter run, and one disagreement fails the gate. Every
# other variant keeps the old gate (a constructor in lean/trust_ir-semantics).
# A sub-feature SemR refuses by name (`unsupported <feature>`, e.g. a float
# operand) stays refused; the fragment is the instruction, not every type.
# Quoted-only model constructors are accounted for separately in
# QUOTED_MODEL.tsv. They remain decoder-refused and earn no credit here.
